review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: It is argued that praises should be given to straight-A students, however, some others say no full marks students but improvement students are really deserve. Personally, I think both of them are need to rewarded.

On the one hand, I acknowledged that rewarding to straight-A students is respectable. Since student have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, which in turn propel towards academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition can be easily seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. It naturally follows that students are gradually used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, thereby enabling them to achieve success in later life.

However, I believe that students who show their effortness and improvements should be rewarded. When only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, may cause others to think that their effort is futile because they can not surpass those outstanding individuals. This sense of feeling overwhelmed and disheartened may well gradually lose theirs incentive to study. By contrast, emphasizing improvements may encourage all students to be diligent in their studies as well as help students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. Ultimately, the constant desire to outdo themselves, even benefit themselves more than the competitive to win against all others.
In conclusion, I believe that praise should be given to both best and improving students.
review.overall: Em đã nêu rõ hướng thưởng cả hai nhóm và triển khai được đủ bốn ý chính. Em cần sửa cấu trúc câu, nhất là câu điều kiện ở thân bài 2, để quan hệ nguyên nhân–kết quả rõ và chính xác.

paragraphs: Opinions are divided over whether schools should reward students with the best academic results or whether it is more important to reward students who show progress. I believe that both groups need to be rewarded.

On the one hand, I acknowledge that rewarding straight-A students is reasonable. Since those students have diligently applied themselves to their studies, they deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage them and other students to study harder, thereby propelling students towards academic gains. Furthermore, competition exists in almost every aspect of life. Becoming familiar with it can help students thrive in the face of fierce competition and may prepare them for success in later life.

However, students who show progress should also be rewarded. If only a few high-achieving students receive rewards, this may cause other students to think that their effort is futile because they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, they may feel overwhelmed and disheartened and may gradually lose their incentive to study. By contrast, recognizing improvement can encourage all students to work diligently and to keep improving themselves, irrespective of their current performance. Ultimately, the desire to outdo themselves can even benefit them more than competing against others.
In conclusion, schools should reward both students with outstanding academic results and those who make progress.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
